<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Carta de Amor - Mais Um Mês Juntos</title>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Dancing+Script:wght@400;700&family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=Lato:wght@300;400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>
        * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
        :root { --primary: #8B0000; --secondary: #D4AF37; --bg: #0a0a0a; --text: #f5f5f5; --accent: #ff6b6b; }
        body { font-family: 'Lato', sans-serif; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); overflow-x: hidden; line-height: 1.6; }
        .hearts { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1; overflow: hidden; }
        .heart { position: absolute; font-size: 20px; color: var(--accent); opacity: 0; animation: float 10s infinite; }
        @keyframes float { 0% { transform: translateY(100vh) rotate(0deg); opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 0.6; } 90% { opacity: 0.6; } 100% { transform: translateY(-100vh) rotate(720deg); opacity: 0; } }
        .container { position: relative; z-index: 2; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 20px; }
        .header { text-align: center; padding: 60px 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,0,0,0.3) 0%, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%); border-radius: 20px; margin-bottom: 40px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
        .header::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -50%; left: -50%; width: 200%; height: 200%; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(212,175,55,0.1) 0%, transparent 70%); animation: pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; }
        @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.5; } 50% { transform: scale(1.1); opacity: 0.8; } }
        .month-badge { display: inline-block; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary), #b8941f); color: var(--bg); padding: 15px 40px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,0.3); position: relative; z-index: 1; }
        .title { font-family: 'Dancing Script', cursive; font-size: 4rem; color: var(--secondary); margin: 20px 0; text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(212,175,55,0.5); position: relative; z-index: 1; }
        .subtitle { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.3rem; color: #aaa; font-style: italic; position: relative; z-index: 1; }

        /* Seção de Música */
        .music-section { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,0,0,0.2), rgba(212,175,55,0.1)); border: 2px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.3); border-radius: 20px; padding: 40px; margin-bottom: 40px; text-align: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
        .music-section::before { content: '🎵'; position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 30px; font-size: 4rem; opacity: 0.1; }
        .music-title { font-family: 'Dancing Script', cursive; font-size: 2.5rem; color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 20px; }
        .music-subtitle { color: #aaa; margin-bottom: 30px; font-style: italic; }
        .music-player-container { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5); border-radius: 15px; padding: 30px; margin: 20px 0; border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2); }
        .play-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 15px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary), #b8941f); color: var(--bg); padding: 20px 50px; border-radius: 50px; font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.3s ease; border: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(212,175,55,0.3); }
        .play-button:hover { transform: translateY(-5px) scale(1.05); box-shadow: 0 15px 40px rgba(212,175,55,0.5); }
        .play-icon { font-size: 1.5rem; }
        .music-note { font-size: 3rem; margin: 10px; animation: bounce 2s infinite; display: inline-block; }
        @keyframes bounce { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-10px); } }

        .letter-section { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2); border-radius: 20px; padding: 50px; margin-bottom: 40px; position: relative; backdrop-filter: blur(10px); }
        .letter-section::before { content: '"'; position: absolute; top: 20px; left: 30px; font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 8rem; color: rgba(212,175,55,0.1); line-height: 1; }
        .letter-text { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; font-size: 1.2rem; line-height: 2; color: #e0e0e0; text-align: justify; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
        .letter-text p { margin-bottom: 20px; text-indent: 30px; }
        .highlight { color: var(--secondary); font-weight: 700; }
        .gallery-section { margin-bottom: 40px; }
        .section-title { font-family: 'Dancing Script', cursive; font-size: 3rem; color: var(--secondary); text-align: center; margin-bottom: 40px; }
        .photo-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
        .photo-card { position: relative; border-radius: 15px; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 3/4; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.5s ease; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); background: #1a1a1a; }
        .photo-card:hover { transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(212,175,55,0.2); }
        .photo-card img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; transition: transform 0.5s ease; display: block; }
        .photo-card:hover img { transform: scale(1.1); }
        .photo-overlay { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,0.9)); padding: 30px 20px 20px; transform: translateY(100%); transition: transform 0.3s ease; }
        .photo-card:hover .photo-overlay { transform: translateY(0); }
        .photo-caption { font-family: 'Dancing Script', cursive; font-size: 1.5rem; color: var(--secondary); }
        .timeline-section { margin-bottom: 40px; }
        .timeline { position: relative; padding: 20px 0; }
        .timeline::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); width: 2px; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--secondary), transparent); }
        .timeline-item { display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; margin: 40px 0; position: relative; }
        .timeline-content { background: rgba(139,0,0,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.3); padding: 20px 30px; border-radius: 15px; max-width: 300px; text-align: center; position: relative; }
        .timeline-dot { width: 20px; height: 20px; background: var(--secondary); border-radius: 50%; position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.5); }
        .footer { text-align: center; padding: 60px 20px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139,0,0,0.2) 0%, transparent 100%); border-radius: 20px; position: relative; }
        .signature { font-family: 'Dancing Script', cursive; font-size: 3rem; color: var(--secondary); margin-top: 20px; }
        .date { font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif; color: #666; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 1.1rem; }
        .music-btn { position: fixed; bottom: 30px; right: 30px; width: 60px; height: 60px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--secondary), #b8941f); border: none; border-radius: 50%; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 24px; box-shadow: 0 5px 20px rgba(212,175,55,0.4); transition: all 0.3s ease; z-index: 100; }
        .music-btn:hover { transform: scale(1.1); box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(212,175,55,0.6); }
        .modal { display: none; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.95); z-index: 1000; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 20px; }
        .modal.active { display: flex; }
        .modal img { max-width: 100%; max-height: 90vh; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 0 50px rgba(212,175,55,0.3); }
        .modal-close { position: absolute; top: 20px; right: 30px; font-size: 3rem; color: var(--secondary); cursor: pointer; background: none; border: none; }
        @media (max-width: 768px) { .title { font-size: 2.5rem; } .section-title { font-size: 2rem; } .letter-section { padding: 30px 20px; } .letter-text { font-size: 1rem; } .photo-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .photo-card { aspect-ratio: 4/5; } .music-title { font-size: 2rem; } .play-button { padding: 15px 30px; font-size: 1.1rem; } }
        .fade-in { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); transition: all 0.8s ease; }
        .fade-in.visible { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    </style>
<base target="_blank">
</head>
<body>
    <div class="hearts" id="hearts"></div>
    <div class="modal" id="modal">
        <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal()">&times;</button>
        <img src="" alt="Foto ampliada" id="modalImg">
    </div>
    <div class="container">
        <header class="header fade-in">
            <div class="month-badge">💑 Mais Um Mês de Nós</div>
            <h1 class="title">Nossa História</h1>
            <p class="subtitle">Ontem completamos mais um capítulo dessa linda jornada</p>
        </header>

        <!-- Seção da Música -->
        <section class="music-section fade-in">
            <h2 class="music-title">🎵 Nossa Música</h2>
            <p class="music-subtitle">A trilha sonora do nosso amor</p>

            <div class="music-player-container">
                <div class="music-note">🎶</div>
                <div class="music-note" style="animation-delay: 0.5s;">💕</div>
                <div class="music-note" style="animation-delay: 1s;">🎵</div>
                <br><br>
                <a href="https://www.producer.ai/song/415cf963-fe28-4b3e-9f51-83a506ce3faa" target="_blank" class="play-button">
                    <span class="play-icon">▶️</span>
                    <span>Tocar Nossa Música</span>
                </a>
                <p style="margin-top: 20px; color: #888; font-size: 0.9rem;">Clique para ouvir no Producer.ai</p>
            </div>
        </section>

        <section class="letter-section fade-in">
            <div class="letter-text">
                <p>Meu amor,</p>
                <p>Ontem, quando o relógio marcou a meia-noite, <span class="highlight">mais um mês se completou</span> na nossa história. E eu não poderia deixar de registrar em palavras o que sinto por você.</p>
                <p>São <span class="highlight">30 dias a mais</span> de risadas compartilhadas, de olhares que dizem mais que mil palavras, de abraços que curam qualquer cansaço. Cada mês ao seu lado me mostra que o amor não precisa ser perfeito — ele só precisa ser verdadeiro, como o nosso.</p>
                <p>Olho para essas fotos e ouço nossa música, e me lembro de cada momento especial. Você é a minha pessoa favorita, minha paz em dias turbulentos, minha alegria nas manhãs simples. Obrigado por mais esse mês de amor, cumplicidade e parceria.</p>
                <p style="text-align: center; margin-top: 30px; font-style: italic;">Te amo hoje, amanhã e sempre. ❤️</p>
            </div>
        </section>
        <section class="gallery-section fade-in">
            <h2 class="section-title">Nossos Momentos</h2>
            <div class="photo-grid">
                <div class="photo-card" onclick="openModal('data:image/jpeg;base64,------')">
                    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,------" alt="Momento especial 1" loading="lazy">
                    <div class="photo-overlay">
                        <span class="photo-caption">Seu sorriso é minha paz ☺️</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="photo-card" onclick="openModal('data:image/jpeg;base64,----------6aMBLYLbQv6i5N5y7bC5SajqSjHPzt8UJUqbZ8a/9k=')">
                    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,----------6aMBLYLbQv6i5N5y7bC5SajqSjHPzt8UJUqbZ8a/9k=" alt="Momento especial 2" loading="lazy">
                    <div class="photo-overlay">
                        <span class="photo-caption">Preto e branco, colorido de amor 🖤</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="photo-card" onclick="openModal('data:image/jpeg;base64,--------6aMBLYLbQv6i5N5y7bC5SajqSjHPzt8UJUqbZ8a//2Q==')">
                    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,--------6aMBLYLbQv6i5N5y7bC5SajqSjHPzt8UJUqbZ8a//2Q==" alt="Momento especial 3" loading="lazy">
                    <div class="photo-overlay">
                        <span class="photo-caption">Nossas caretas favoritas 😜</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="photo-card" onclick="openModal('data:image/jpeg;base64,')">
                    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Momento especial 4" loading="lazy">
                    <div class="photo-overlay">
                        <span class="photo-caption">Juntos em qualquer lugar 🏠</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="photo-card" onclick="openModal('data:image/jpeg;base64,--------------')">
                    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64,--------------" alt="Momento especial 5" loading="lazy">
                    <div class="photo-overlay">
                        <span class="photo-caption">Meu lugar favorito: ao seu lado 💕</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
        <section class="timeline-section fade-in">
            <h2 class="section-title">Nossa Jornada</h2>
            <div class="timeline">
                <div class="timeline-item">
                    <div class="timeline-content">
                        <h3 style="color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 10px;">💕 O Começo</h3>
                        <p>Aquele primeiro olhar que mudou tudo</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="timeline-dot"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="timeline-item">
                    <div class="timeline-content">
                        <h3 style="color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 10px;">🎵 Nossa Música</h3>
                        <p>A trilha sonora que nos une</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="timeline-dot"></div>
                </div>
                <div class="timeline-item">
                    <div class="timeline-content">
                        <h3 style="color: var(--secondary); margin-bottom: 10px;">🔮 O Futuro</h3>
                        <p>Todos os meses que ainda vamos viver</p>
                    </div>
                    <div class="timeline-dot"></div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </section>
        <footer class="footer fade-in">
            <p style="font-size: 1.2rem; color: #aaa;">Com todo meu amor,</p>
            <div class="signature">Seu Amor</div>
            <div class="date">Fevereiro de 2026</div>
            <div style="margin-top: 30px; font-size: 3rem;">❤️🎵</div>
        </footer>
    </div>
    <button class="music-btn" onclick="window.open('https://www.producer.ai/song/415cf963-fe28-4b3e-9f51-83a506ce3faa', '_blank')" title="Tocar nossa música">🎵</button>
    <script>
        function openModal(src) { document.getElementById('modalImg').src = src; document.getElementById('modal').classList.add('active'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
        function closeModal() { document.getElementById('modal').classList.remove('active'); document.body.style.overflow = 'auto'; }
        document.getElementById('modal').addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === this) closeModal(); });
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeModal(); });
        function createHearts() { const heartsContainer = document.getElementById('hearts'); const heartSymbols = ['❤️', '💖', '💕', '💗', '🎵', '🎶']; setInterval(() => { const heart = document.createElement('div'); heart.className = 'heart'; heart.innerHTML = heartSymbols[Math.floor(Math.random() * heartSymbols.length)]; heart.style.left = Math.random() * 100 + '%'; heart.style.animationDuration = (Math.random() * 5 + 5) + 's'; heart.style.fontSize = (Math.random() * 20 + 10) + 'px'; heartsContainer.appendChild(heart); setTimeout(() => heart.remove(), 10000); }, 800); }
        function handleScroll() { const elements = document.querySelectorAll('.fade-in'); elements.forEach(element => { const elementTop = element.getBoundingClientRect().top; if (elementTop < window.innerHeight - 150) element.classList.add('visible'); }); }
        window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);
        window.addEventListener('load', () => { createHearts(); handleScroll(); });
        const title = document.querySelector('.title'); const originalText = title.textContent; title.textContent = ''; let i = 0;
        function typeWriter() { if (i < originalText.length) { title.textContent += originalText.charAt(i); i++; setTimeout(typeWriter, 150); } }
        setTimeout(typeWriter, 500);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
